newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint closes slightly softer vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint closes slightly softer vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint tracked the dollar/mark's movements in Europe and finished Monday's trading slightly lower against the dollar, dealers said.
The forint closed at 154.90/95, compared with its opening of 154.88/93 and a 154.88/93 quote at noon.
Dealers said trading was lacklustre. Only the early afternoon hours brought some activity in dollar/forint and mark/forint deals, with the dollar gaining some ground against the mark.
